reviews.text: Kerrys assistance was invaluable I went from a total beginner to a confident puppy owner with the puppy gold pack. It's not really about training the dog but training you with the required abilities. Kerry is extremely informative and always helpful it was a joy to work with her.

I'd definitely recommend Kerry's Wigglebutts class because it's a friendly and safe environment to take your dog to learn fun tips, tricks and actions which helps build confidence and connection together. It's so good for dogs to learn stuff like this.
Kerry's patient, knowledgeable and really easy to talk to. She'll give you homework to work on away from class to keep you both engaged - my Dolly absolutely loves it 🐾

Group classes are great, small classes of only 6 dogs so Kerry has time to teach each dog. We love them, Arlo goes home mentally tired after a fun hour of using his brain and learning a few tricks on the way !
An excellent session with Kerry. Can't wait to put her advice into practise.

Kerry was amazing. She established a rapport almost instantly with our dog. She wasted no time  in asking questions following up on the pre questionnaire we had already filled in before our first session.
She addressed key issues with some excellent and practical techniques to help resolve them.
She also picked up on medical and health issues with suggestions to resolve them also.
We received an email report shortly after Kerry’s first visit with a full breakdown of our session and exercises to work on with our dog.
We have put these into practice and seen some remarkable results already.
Really looking forward to working with Kerry  again and I’m sure so is our dog Luna who received lots of lovely treats from her.
Hi couldn’t recommend The Fairy Dog Mother more highly. Extremely pleasant and professional. Myself and my daughter are very happy with the results and enjoying a better behaved doggy.
Alan Young.

We have a very strong and full on Boston terrier, Denzel. I was unable to walk him without my husband. With the help from Kerry we now have a calmer Denzel that I am able to walk by myself. It’s so nice to spend time with him now.
